title: Physical warehouse
description: Manage locations and physical warehouse layout.

config.title: Physical warehouse category config
config.description: Define names and order of warehouse levels (e.g. Warehouse → Rack → Shelf → Box).
config.empty: No levels yet. Add at least one level.
config.hint: Level 1 is the highest. The last level is the lowest (has capacity).
config.lockedHint: Warehouse data exists: only the lowest level stays pinned last (you can rename it). Add or remove other levels, use ↑↓ to reorder, then save. When the structure changes with existing data, you will be asked whether to migrate data.
config.migrateDescription: Adding or removing levels shifts the current structure. Choose migrate to apply the new configuration (auto-wrap when adding, or hoist data to the parent level when removing).
config.bottomPinned: The lowest level must stay last — it cannot be reordered away from the bottom.

locations.title: Location management
locations.description: Add, edit, and delete physical warehouse locations.

diagram.empty: No data in this location yet.
diagram.moveHint: Click a box to select it, then click a target row/shelf to move.
diagram.moveSuccess: Box moved to the new location

manage.dossiersEmpty: No dossiers in this box yet.
manage.unplacedEmpty: No archived dossiers without a physical location.
manage.boxFull: This box is full — cannot add more dossiers.
manage.placeLimitHint: Select at most {{remaining}} dossiers based on remaining capacity.

capacity.label: Capacity
capacity.minUsed: Capacity must be ≥ dossiers currently in the box ({{used}})
capacity.minUsedHint: There are currently {{used}} dossiers — capacity cannot be lower.

delete.confirmDescription: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
delete.hasChildren: Cannot delete because this item still has children. Delete the children first.
delete.hasPlacements: Cannot delete because this box still has dossiers.

errors.loadFailed: Failed to load physical warehouse data
errors.noLevels: Warehouse levels are not configured yet. Configure them first.
